snippet.title: SWORD FLINGER Main Trailer
snippet.description:
SWORD FLINGER is OUT NOW on Steam!

Throw swords, spears, axes, and more in this roguelite action game!

Bounce weapons off walls and enemies, trigger powerful chain attacks, and combine different weapons and upgrades to create your own strategies.

Fight through three areas, defeat powerful bosses, and uncover the mystery of the protagonist's massive gauntlet!

⚔️ Available Now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4474400/

Developed and published by TOM CREATE CO., LTD.

Official Website:
https://www.tomcreate.co.jp/
